title: Common definitions
description: Building blocks shared by every contract. Not an entity on its own: other schemas reference these $defs.

ulid.description: ULID: 26 characters of Crockford base32. Immutable, assigned by the system that owns the record.

code.description: Lowercase snake code, as UnoPim uses for attributes, channels, categories and families.

locale.description: Locale code as UnoPim writes it, e.g. nl_NL or en_US.

localized-text.description: Text per locale, keyed by locale code.

provenance.description: Where a value came from, for values that were not typed in by the owner.

locked.description: True when the value must not be overwritten by a later import.
